description: Create and manage paid ads with Omneky in ChatGPT — performance, catalogue, image/video creatives, and multi-channel launch after you confirm.

defaultPrompt: Show my brands and this week's top ROAS ads.
Import this product URL, generate a branded image ad, then prepare a Meta sales launch (wait for my confirm).
Generate 3 product video ads for my top catalogue item.
interface.longDescription:
Create ads, creatives, and performance workflows with Omneky in ChatGPT. Sign in once with Omneky OAuth, pick a brand, then review ROAS, manage the product catalogue, generate image and video ads, and launch or pause campaigns on Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, Pinterest, and X.

With Omneky, you can:
• Review performance — See ROAS, CTR, movers, and recommendations for which ads to make more of.
• Manage catalogue — List products or import a product URL into the brand catalogue.
• Create creatives — Generate branded image ads and product videos; edit and resize.
• Launch and manage — Connect channels, launch campaigns, pause ads, and change budgets after you confirm.

Connect your Omneky account to get started.
